assumption: TSA24/BC Stage A pilot supply area is a diagnostic scale, not a TSA supply estimate.
impact: All volumes scale linearly with this value.

assumption: Assortment matrix rows are per-hectare values; the pilot multiplies by the diagnostic area.
impact: Base volume is area x matrix volume; no additional yield expansion.

assumption: Roadside cost is the assortment matrix price_cad_m3 proxy, not a harvest/stumpage cost.
impact: Changes the profit margin; transport and processing remain explicit.

assumption: Residue volume uses the ledger 0.45 ODT/m3 basic density and 0.45 wet-basis moisture.
impact: Residue ODT is volume x 0.45; matrix species-specific residue_odt is not used.

assumption: Log moisture is set to the ledger green assumption because the matrix has no log moisture field.
impact: Only relevant if a moisture blend limit is enabled.

assumption: m3/y infeed is used directly; odt/y and bdmt/y infeed use the declared 0.45 ODT/m3 density; admt/y is rejected without a declared air-dry moisture; mbf/y is rejected without a declared recovery factor; energy units cannot become volume.
impact: PAP bdmt/y alternatives convert below the paired m3/y log line, so product capacity is unchanged.

assumption: Facility nameplate is the sum of the maximum normalized capacity per primary product; feedstock alternatives are not additive.
impact: Prevents counting the same FFCM line once per feedstock alternative.

assumption: Coordinates use Mills DB first, CFS suppliers.dbf second, an FFCM TL/water hub proxy third, and missing last; no Euclidean guesses are used.
impact: TL/water proxy uses the median coordinate of geocoded facilities directly attached to the same hub; confidence is low.

assumption: Stage A scope coordinate coverage is tracked separately from all BC facilities.
impact: Missing coordinates do not fabricate a location and do not by themselves exclude a facility from the LP.

assumption: The TSA24 supply anchor is a geocoded Prince George mill proxy because no TSA24 FMU exists in the FFCM graph.
impact: Anchor coordinate is Mills DB 53.99,-122.69 (BC-SAW-488); all distances are relative to this proxy.

assumption: Distances are FFCM route-graph shortest paths from the anchor through TL nodes, not Euclidean distances.
impact: Median graph distance is 920.6438935022001 km versus 261.238130978 km in the previous 150 km diagnostic.

assumption: Road and rail costs use BC transporters with archive fuel and operating rates and material capacities; transload costs are added at each TL node.
impact: Combination paths use the actual leg mode; no global average rate is assumed.

assumption: FFCM route capacity is absent from the parsed route table; every transport link is uncapped.
impact: capacity=None and capacity_source=absent; do not interpret congestion or rail/water limits.

assumption: Contracts are diagnostic: min=0 and max=facility nameplate; no populated real contract table exists.
impact: contract_source=diagnostic_absent on every contract; compliance is a bound check, not commercial evidence.

assumption: Unassigned supply carries a diagnostic penalty so that feasible supply is not silently dropped.
impact: The penalty is reported as a separate objective component.

assumption: Assortment sorts are dimension-only; no BC official grade equivalence is claimed.
impact: Grade eligibility is a feedstock-class/product screen, not a grade-quality test.

assumption: MKRF is not used anywhere in this pilot.
impact: No MKRF input or output is read or written.
